MiniMax H3 image-to-video. Image1 is the set-dressing and distant-identity reference (not the first frame — this shot opens on a low wide from behind the kneeling courtiers). Single continuous 5-second reaction shot, cinematic live-action period-drama realism.

[REFERENCE USE]
Image1: set-dressing reference for the hall — black marble pillars, gilded lattice screens, lit candelabras, golden throne — and identity reference for the empress visible only as a small distant figure on the throne: black gown with golden bamboo-leaf embroidery, golden phoenix headdress.

[IDENTITY AND CONTINUITY LOCKS]
The distant throne figure matches Image1's empress silhouette; the hall's pillars, screens, candles and throne match Image1's design; the courtiers' costume design stays uniform within each row for every frame.

[SCENE]
Low wide from behind the courtiers: two long rows of kneeling officials in deep-crimson and dark-indigo court robes with black gauze caps, flanking the central stone aisle, foreheads lowered toward the floor, sleeves pooled on stone; at the far end the raised platform, golden throne, and the empress as a small still figure.

[SHOT TIMELINE]
0.0–1.5 seconds — Hold the low wide: the whole hall kneels in silence; only candle flames flicker; the distant empress sits motionless on the throne.
1.5–3.5 seconds — A slow low lateral track glides along the bowed heads; as the camera passes, each courtier lowers his head a fraction deeper in sequence — a quiet wave of submission rolling down the rows; robes rustle against stone.
3.5–5.0 seconds — The track settles on the front-row courtier, forehead touching the stone, shoulders tight with held breath; candlelight rims the black gauze caps; hold the prostration.

[CAMERA]
Low-angle lateral track at kneeling-head height, constant slow speed, then a gentle settle on the front row; no cuts, no shake, no tilt drift; the aisle and far throne stay visible at the frame's center line.

[LIGHT AND IMAGE]
Deep shadowed hall, pools of warm candlelight rimming the black caps and crimson shoulders, the far throne glow-lit; thin incense smoke in the light shafts; clean transparent image, filmic highlight rolloff, Arri Alexa-like color science, fine subtle film grain; live-action realistic period-drama look — not anime, not 3D, not CG.

[PRODUCTION SOUND]
A rolling rustle of court robes against stone as the wave of bows deepens, muffled held breaths, faint candle-flame crackle, deep quiet hall room-tone; no music, no dialogue, no voice-over.

[CONTINUITY]
Hall architecture and dressing identical to Image1; the distant empress silhouette unchanged; courtiers stay kneeling throughout — no one stands, no one raises a face; row spacing and candle placement consistent during the track.

[NEGATIVES]
No raised or visible faces (heads stay bowed, faces hidden), no standing figures, no empty gaps or popping courtiers in the rows, no modern clothing or accessories, no warped perspective, no bending pillars, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no narration, no background music, no anime / 3D / CG look, no flickering architecture, no oversaturation, no watermark, no logo.
